traits.sympodium.note: Britton and Brown, Illustrated Flora, 2nd ed. vol. 3 (1913), Datura (genus account), c. p. 170 (read on the Internet Archive, 2026-10-17): erect, tall, branching herbs; Gray (p. 717) and Bentham (p. 317) put the flowers in the forks of the branching stem, Bentham's branches forked and spreading.

traits.inflorescence.note: Britton and Brown, Illustrated Flora, 2nd ed. vol. 3 (1913), Datura, c. p. 170 (read on the Internet Archive, 2026-10-17): flowers large, solitary, short-peduncled.

traits.corolla_shape.note: Britton and Brown, Illustrated Flora, 2nd ed. vol. 3 (1913), Datura, c. p. 170 (read on the Internet Archive, 2026-10-17): corolla funnelform with a plaited limb; Bailey (vol. 2, p. 970): trumpet-shaped with a spreading 5-10-toothed limb.

traits.fruit_type.note: Britton and Brown, Illustrated Flora, 2nd ed. vol. 3 (1913), Datura, c. p. 170 (read on the Internet Archive, 2026-10-17): a capsule opening by 4 valves (D. stramonium); Gray p. 717: 4-valved.
